# Any scope. Effective threshold (temp cwcm_t_thr_eff): 2 no Against, 4 interested (no Against), 5 two thirds (supranational), 6 interested (Against counts as not interested).
COLDWAR_CMEA_effective_rules = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_thr_eff = cwcm_t_thr }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_epm = 0 }
	# a supranational planning organ decides recommendations by two thirds, without opting out
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_thr = 4 }
			has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_supranational }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_thr_eff = 5 }
	}
	# Charter 1979: the non-participation of some does not block the interested members
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_thr = 4 }
			has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_interest_unblocked }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_thr_eff = 6 }
	}
}

# Any scope. The one-off item in the context is in a file.

# Any scope. A rejected one-off item returns after 180 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock = {
	# IMPERIA COLD WAR — Report the defeated accession vote to the North Korean applicant.
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target = NKO.id } country_exists = NKO }
		NKO = { if = { limit = { has_completed_focus = COLDWAR_NKO_comecon_application IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes } if = { limit = { is_ai = no } country_event = { id = ICW_NKO_1970_feedback.51 } } } }
	}

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 1 } }
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_lock_A1 days = 180 value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 2 } }
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_lock_A2 days = 180 value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 3 } }
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_lock_A3 days = 180 value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 4 } }

		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 44 } }
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_lock_C4 days = 365 value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 45 } }
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_lock_C5 days = 365 value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 46 } }
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_lock_C6 days = 365 value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = 47 } }
		set_global_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_lock_C7 days = 365 value = 1 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 1 into the read-only context used by item effects and texts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_slot = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = global.cwcm_s1_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_phase = global.cwcm_s1_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_stage = global.cwcm_s1_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_due = global.cwcm_s1_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_issue = global.cwcm_s1_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target = global.cwcm_s1_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_opt = global.cwcm_s1_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_size = global.cwcm_s1_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ret = global.cwcm_s1_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_by = global.cwcm_s1_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ticket = global.cwcm_s1_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ptime = global.cwcm_s1_ptime }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_since = global.cwcm_s1_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_len = global.cwcm_s1_len }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_proc = global.cwcm_s1_proc }
}

# Any scope. Closes file 1.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_free = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_unbusy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 0 }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s1_part
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_ptime = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_len = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_proc = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 1 waits for the Executive Committee (or the June Session).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_ticket = global.cwcm_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 1.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_due = cwcm_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_len = cwcm_t_days }
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 1 with the temp request (cwcm_t_item, target, opt, size, ret).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_item = cwcm_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_target = cwcm_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_opt = cwcm_t_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_size = cwcm_t_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_ret = cwcm_t_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_stage = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_by = THIS.id }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_ptime = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_busy = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_pay_request = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s1_target = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_draft = 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 1 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_workload = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_load }
		round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_days
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_phase_for = yes
		# the Secretary sees the draft on the desk and may table it at once or decline it
	}
}

# Any scope. File 1 goes to the vote for 30 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_open_vote = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_effective_rules = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_phase_for = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_due = global.cwcm_s1_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = cwcm_t_thr_eff }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ep = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_stage = global.cwcm_s1_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_item = global.cwcm_s1_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_target = global.cwcm_s1_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_size = global.cwcm_s1_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_opt = global.cwcm_s1_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ret = global.cwcm_s1_ret }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.1 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts the players on file 1; adopted files move on, rejected files close.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_close = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = cwcm_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 } }
		# a resolution of the catalogue makes world news in the next step (passed); other files notify the members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_bind = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			# world news: under the rules of consent an Against blocks - the news names the first player member that voted Against
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_last_na > 0 }
					OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 4 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwcm_members
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
							is_ai = no
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s1_issue }
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 2 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = THIS.id }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = cwcm_t_nw }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quorum = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = 99 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_failed = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. The members bound by file 1: every member for a decision; for a recommendation the players who voted For and the passive members.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_bind = {
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s1_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				OR = {
					is_ai = yes
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 5 }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s1_issue } check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 1 } }
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { global.cwcm_s1_part = THIS }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 1 after an adopted vote.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_passed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	# the partner or applicant of the file no longer exists: the file closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s1_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_free = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwcm_s1_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_status = 4 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 6 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jul1 = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_next }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = global.num_days }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 90 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 8 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_target > 0 }
					var:global.cwcm_s1_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_ptime = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_since = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_len = 60 }
				var:global.cwcm_s1_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev4_item = global.cwcm_s1_item } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.4 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_accept = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_transp > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_transp }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_phase_for = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_apply = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 1 rejected; one-off items return after 180 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_failed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_free = yes
}

# Any scope. File 1 enters into force (for the members bound by it).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_apply = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	clear_array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_s1_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwcm_ctx_part = THIS } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s1_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the partner or applicant no longer exists: nothing enters into force
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s1_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_accession_effective = yes }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_project = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_aid = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_free = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 1 accepts (or is a passive country).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_accept = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_due = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_apply = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 1 declines or does not answer in 60 days of play.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_decline = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_by > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_s1_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwcm_s1_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s1_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 7 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_target = global.cwcm_s1_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Offers wait for players: the deadline only runs in weeks when the partner is played; a passive country accepts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s1_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_decline = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s1_target = { is_ai = no } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_ptime = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_ptime < 60 } } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_decline = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s1_target = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_accept = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Starts the national ratification of file 1: players decide within 365 days, passive members after their period.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_rat_begin = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_1 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_1 = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_1 = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_1 = cwcm_ratdays }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ev3_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.3 }
	}
}

# Any scope. File 1 goes to the national ratifications.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_start_ratify = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_rat_begin = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Weekly step of the ratification of file 1.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_rat_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 1 } check_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwcm_ratdue_1 } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_rat_failer = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly ratification check of file 1; in force one month after the last ratification.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ratify_tick = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_rat_step = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = global.cwcm_rat_failer }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock_defeat = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 9 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 20 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Ratify file 1 by the national assembly (90 days, 25 political power).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_rat_parliament = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_1 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_1 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_1 = 90 }
	add_political_power = -25
}

# Country scope. Refuses to ratify file 1; the change of the Charter fails.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_rat_refuse = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_1 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 1.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 10 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_s1_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { COLDWAR_CMEA_project_slot_free = yes AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_item > 120 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_item < 140 } } } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 2 into the read-only context used by item effects and texts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_slot = 2 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = global.cwcm_s2_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_phase = global.cwcm_s2_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_stage = global.cwcm_s2_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_due = global.cwcm_s2_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_issue = global.cwcm_s2_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target = global.cwcm_s2_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_opt = global.cwcm_s2_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_size = global.cwcm_s2_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ret = global.cwcm_s2_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_by = global.cwcm_s2_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ticket = global.cwcm_s2_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ptime = global.cwcm_s2_ptime }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_since = global.cwcm_s2_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_len = global.cwcm_s2_len }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_proc = global.cwcm_s2_proc }
}

# Any scope. Closes file 2.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_free = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_unbusy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 0 }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s2_part
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_ptime = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_len = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_proc = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 2 waits for the Executive Committee (or the June Session).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_ticket = global.cwcm_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 2.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_due = cwcm_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_len = cwcm_t_days }
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 2 with the temp request (cwcm_t_item, target, opt, size, ret).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_item = cwcm_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_target = cwcm_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_opt = cwcm_t_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_size = cwcm_t_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_ret = cwcm_t_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_stage = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_by = THIS.id }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_ptime = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_busy = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_pay_request = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s2_target = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_draft = 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 1 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_workload = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_load }
		round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_days
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_phase_for = yes
		# the Secretary sees the draft on the desk and may table it at once or decline it
	}
}

# Any scope. File 2 goes to the vote for 30 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_open_vote = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_effective_rules = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_phase_for = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 2 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_due = global.cwcm_s2_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = cwcm_t_thr_eff }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ep = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_stage = global.cwcm_s2_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_item = global.cwcm_s2_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_target = global.cwcm_s2_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_size = global.cwcm_s2_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_opt = global.cwcm_s2_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ret = global.cwcm_s2_ret }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.1 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts the players on file 2; adopted files move on, rejected files close.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_close = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = cwcm_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 } }
		# a resolution of the catalogue makes world news in the next step (passed); other files notify the members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_bind = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			# world news: under the rules of consent an Against blocks - the news names the first player member that voted Against
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_last_na > 0 }
					OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 4 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwcm_members
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
							is_ai = no
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s2_issue }
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 2 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = THIS.id }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = cwcm_t_nw }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quorum = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = 99 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_failed = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. The members bound by file 2: every member for a decision; for a recommendation the players who voted For and the passive members.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_bind = {
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s2_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				OR = {
					is_ai = yes
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 5 }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s2_issue } check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 1 } }
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { global.cwcm_s2_part = THIS }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 2 after an adopted vote.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_passed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	# the partner or applicant of the file no longer exists: the file closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s2_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_free = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwcm_s2_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_status = 4 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 6 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jul1 = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_next }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = global.num_days }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 90 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 8 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_target > 0 }
					var:global.cwcm_s2_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_ptime = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_since = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_len = 60 }
				var:global.cwcm_s2_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev4_item = global.cwcm_s2_item } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.4 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_accept = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_transp > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_transp }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_phase_for = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_apply = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 2 rejected; one-off items return after 180 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_failed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_free = yes
}

# Any scope. File 2 enters into force (for the members bound by it).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_apply = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	clear_array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_s2_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwcm_ctx_part = THIS } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s2_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the partner or applicant no longer exists: nothing enters into force
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s2_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_accession_effective = yes }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_project = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_aid = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_free = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 2 accepts (or is a passive country).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_accept = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_due = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_apply = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 2 declines or does not answer in 60 days of play.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_decline = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_by > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_s2_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwcm_s2_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s2_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 7 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_target = global.cwcm_s2_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Offers wait for players: the deadline only runs in weeks when the partner is played; a passive country accepts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s2_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_decline = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s2_target = { is_ai = no } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_ptime = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_ptime < 60 } } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_decline = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s2_target = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_accept = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Starts the national ratification of file 2: players decide within 365 days, passive members after their period.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_rat_begin = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_2 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_2 = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_2 = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_2 = cwcm_ratdays }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ev3_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.3 }
	}
}

# Any scope. File 2 goes to the national ratifications.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_start_ratify = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_rat_begin = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Weekly step of the ratification of file 2.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_rat_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 1 } check_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwcm_ratdue_2 } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_rat_failer = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly ratification check of file 2; in force one month after the last ratification.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ratify_tick = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_rat_step = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = global.cwcm_rat_failer }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock_defeat = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 9 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 20 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Ratify file 2 by the national assembly (90 days, 25 political power).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_rat_parliament = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_2 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_2 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_2 = 90 }
	add_political_power = -25
}

# Country scope. Refuses to ratify file 2; the change of the Charter fails.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_rat_refuse = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_2 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 2.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 10 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_s2_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { COLDWAR_CMEA_project_slot_free = yes AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_item > 120 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_item < 140 } } } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 3 into the read-only context used by item effects and texts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_slot = 3 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = global.cwcm_s3_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_phase = global.cwcm_s3_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_stage = global.cwcm_s3_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_due = global.cwcm_s3_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_issue = global.cwcm_s3_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target = global.cwcm_s3_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_opt = global.cwcm_s3_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_size = global.cwcm_s3_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ret = global.cwcm_s3_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_by = global.cwcm_s3_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ticket = global.cwcm_s3_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ptime = global.cwcm_s3_ptime }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_since = global.cwcm_s3_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_len = global.cwcm_s3_len }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_proc = global.cwcm_s3_proc }
}

# Any scope. Closes file 3.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_free = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_unbusy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 3 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 0 }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s3_part
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_ptime = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_len = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_proc = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 3 waits for the Executive Committee (or the June Session).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_ticket = global.cwcm_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 3.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_due = cwcm_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_len = cwcm_t_days }
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 3 with the temp request (cwcm_t_item, target, opt, size, ret).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_item = cwcm_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_target = cwcm_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_opt = cwcm_t_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_size = cwcm_t_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_ret = cwcm_t_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_stage = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_by = THIS.id }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_ptime = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_busy = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_pay_request = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s3_target = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_draft = 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 1 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_workload = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_load }
		round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_days
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_phase_for = yes
		# the Secretary sees the draft on the desk and may table it at once or decline it
	}
}

# Any scope. File 3 goes to the vote for 30 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_open_vote = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_effective_rules = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_phase_for = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 3 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_due = global.cwcm_s3_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = cwcm_t_thr_eff }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ep = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_stage = global.cwcm_s3_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_item = global.cwcm_s3_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_target = global.cwcm_s3_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_size = global.cwcm_s3_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_opt = global.cwcm_s3_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ret = global.cwcm_s3_ret }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.1 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts the players on file 3; adopted files move on, rejected files close.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_close = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = cwcm_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 } }
		# a resolution of the catalogue makes world news in the next step (passed); other files notify the members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_bind = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			# world news: under the rules of consent an Against blocks - the news names the first player member that voted Against
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_last_na > 0 }
					OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 4 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwcm_members
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
							is_ai = no
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s3_issue }
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 2 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = THIS.id }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = cwcm_t_nw }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quorum = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = 99 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_failed = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. The members bound by file 3: every member for a decision; for a recommendation the players who voted For and the passive members.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_bind = {
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s3_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				OR = {
					is_ai = yes
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 5 }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s3_issue } check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 1 } }
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { global.cwcm_s3_part = THIS }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 3 after an adopted vote.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_passed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	# the partner or applicant of the file no longer exists: the file closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s3_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_free = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwcm_s3_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_status = 4 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 6 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jul1 = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_next }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = global.num_days }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 90 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 8 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_target > 0 }
					var:global.cwcm_s3_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_ptime = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_since = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_len = 60 }
				var:global.cwcm_s3_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev4_item = global.cwcm_s3_item } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.4 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_accept = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_transp > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_transp }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_phase_for = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_apply = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 3 rejected; one-off items return after 180 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_failed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_free = yes
}

# Any scope. File 3 enters into force (for the members bound by it).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_apply = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	clear_array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_s3_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwcm_ctx_part = THIS } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s3_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the partner or applicant no longer exists: nothing enters into force
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s3_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_accession_effective = yes }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_project = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_aid = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_free = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 3 accepts (or is a passive country).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_accept = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_due = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_apply = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 3 declines or does not answer in 60 days of play.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_decline = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_by > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_s3_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwcm_s3_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s3_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 7 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_target = global.cwcm_s3_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Offers wait for players: the deadline only runs in weeks when the partner is played; a passive country accepts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s3_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_decline = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s3_target = { is_ai = no } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_ptime = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_ptime < 60 } } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_decline = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s3_target = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_accept = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Starts the national ratification of file 3: players decide within 365 days, passive members after their period.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_rat_begin = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_3 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_3 = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_3 = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_3 = cwcm_ratdays }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ev3_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.3 }
	}
}

# Any scope. File 3 goes to the national ratifications.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_start_ratify = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_rat_begin = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Weekly step of the ratification of file 3.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_rat_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 1 } check_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwcm_ratdue_3 } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_rat_failer = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly ratification check of file 3; in force one month after the last ratification.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ratify_tick = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_rat_step = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = global.cwcm_rat_failer }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock_defeat = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 9 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 20 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Ratify file 3 by the national assembly (90 days, 25 political power).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_rat_parliament = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_3 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_3 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_3 = 90 }
	add_political_power = -25
}

# Country scope. Refuses to ratify file 3; the change of the Charter fails.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_rat_refuse = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_3 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 3.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 10 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_s3_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { COLDWAR_CMEA_project_slot_free = yes AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_item > 120 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_item < 140 } } } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 4 into the read-only context used by item effects and texts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_slot = 4 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = global.cwcm_s4_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_phase = global.cwcm_s4_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_stage = global.cwcm_s4_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_due = global.cwcm_s4_due }
