	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_by = THIS.id }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_ptime = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_busy = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_pay_request = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s7_target = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_draft = 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 1 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_workload = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_load }
		round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_days
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_phase_for = yes
		# the Secretary sees the draft on the desk and may table it at once or decline it
	}
}

# Any scope. File 7 goes to the vote for 30 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_open_vote = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_effective_rules = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_phase_for = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 7 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_due = global.cwcm_s7_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = cwcm_t_thr_eff }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ep = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_stage = global.cwcm_s7_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_item = global.cwcm_s7_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_target = global.cwcm_s7_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_size = global.cwcm_s7_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_opt = global.cwcm_s7_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ret = global.cwcm_s7_ret }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.1 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts the players on file 7; adopted files move on, rejected files close.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_close = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = cwcm_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 } }
		# a resolution of the catalogue makes world news in the next step (passed); other files notify the members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_bind = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			# world news: under the rules of consent an Against blocks - the news names the first player member that voted Against
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_last_na > 0 }
					OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 4 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwcm_members
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
							is_ai = no
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s7_issue }
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 2 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = THIS.id }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = cwcm_t_nw }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quorum = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = 99 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_failed = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. The members bound by file 7: every member for a decision; for a recommendation the players who voted For and the passive members.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_bind = {
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s7_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				OR = {
					is_ai = yes
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 5 }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s7_issue } check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 1 } }
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { global.cwcm_s7_part = THIS }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 7 after an adopted vote.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_passed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	# the partner or applicant of the file no longer exists: the file closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s7_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_free = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwcm_s7_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_status = 4 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 6 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jul1 = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_next }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = global.num_days }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 90 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 8 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_target > 0 }
					var:global.cwcm_s7_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_ptime = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_since = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_len = 60 }
				var:global.cwcm_s7_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev4_item = global.cwcm_s7_item } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.4 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_accept = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_transp > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_transp }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_phase_for = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_apply = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 7 rejected; one-off items return after 180 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_failed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_free = yes
}

# Any scope. File 7 enters into force (for the members bound by it).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_apply = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	clear_array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_s7_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwcm_ctx_part = THIS } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s7_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the partner or applicant no longer exists: nothing enters into force
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s7_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_accession_effective = yes }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_project = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_aid = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_free = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 7 accepts (or is a passive country).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_accept = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_due = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_apply = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 7 declines or does not answer in 60 days of play.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_decline = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_by > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_s7_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwcm_s7_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s7_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 7 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_target = global.cwcm_s7_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Offers wait for players: the deadline only runs in weeks when the partner is played; a passive country accepts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s7_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_decline = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s7_target = { is_ai = no } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_ptime = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_ptime < 60 } } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_decline = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s7_target = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_accept = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Starts the national ratification of file 7: players decide within 365 days, passive members after their period.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_rat_begin = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_7 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_7 = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_7 = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_7 = cwcm_ratdays }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ev3_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.3 }
	}
}

# Any scope. File 7 goes to the national ratifications.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_start_ratify = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ctx = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_rat_begin = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Weekly step of the ratification of file 7.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_rat_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 1 } check_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwcm_ratdue_7 } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_rat_failer = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly ratification check of file 7; in force one month after the last ratification.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ratify_tick = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_rat_step = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = global.cwcm_rat_failer }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock_defeat = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 9 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 20 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Ratify file 7 by the national assembly (90 days, 25 political power).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_rat_parliament = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_7 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_7 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_7 = 90 }
	add_political_power = -25
}

# Country scope. Refuses to ratify file 7; the change of the Charter fails.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_rat_refuse = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_7 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 7.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 10 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_s7_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { COLDWAR_CMEA_project_slot_free = yes AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_item > 120 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_item < 140 } } } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 8 into the read-only context used by item effects and texts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_slot = 8 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = global.cwcm_s8_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_phase = global.cwcm_s8_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_stage = global.cwcm_s8_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_due = global.cwcm_s8_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_issue = global.cwcm_s8_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target = global.cwcm_s8_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_opt = global.cwcm_s8_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_size = global.cwcm_s8_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ret = global.cwcm_s8_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_by = global.cwcm_s8_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ticket = global.cwcm_s8_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ptime = global.cwcm_s8_ptime }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_since = global.cwcm_s8_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_len = global.cwcm_s8_len }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_proc = global.cwcm_s8_proc }
}

# Any scope. Closes file 8.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_free = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_unbusy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 8 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 0 }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s8_part
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_ptime = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_len = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_proc = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 8 waits for the Executive Committee (or the June Session).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_ticket = global.cwcm_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 8.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_due = cwcm_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_len = cwcm_t_days }
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 8 with the temp request (cwcm_t_item, target, opt, size, ret).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_item = cwcm_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_target = cwcm_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_opt = cwcm_t_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_size = cwcm_t_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_ret = cwcm_t_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_stage = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_by = THIS.id }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_ptime = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_busy = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_pay_request = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s8_target = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_draft = 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 1 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_workload = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_load }
		round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_days
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_phase_for = yes
		# the Secretary sees the draft on the desk and may table it at once or decline it
	}
}

# Any scope. File 8 goes to the vote for 30 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_open_vote = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_effective_rules = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_phase_for = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 8 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_due = global.cwcm_s8_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = cwcm_t_thr_eff }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ep = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_stage = global.cwcm_s8_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_item = global.cwcm_s8_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_target = global.cwcm_s8_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_size = global.cwcm_s8_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_opt = global.cwcm_s8_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ret = global.cwcm_s8_ret }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.1 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts the players on file 8; adopted files move on, rejected files close.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_close = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = cwcm_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 } }
		# a resolution of the catalogue makes world news in the next step (passed); other files notify the members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_bind = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			# world news: under the rules of consent an Against blocks - the news names the first player member that voted Against
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_last_na > 0 }
					OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 4 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwcm_members
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
							is_ai = no
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s8_issue }
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 2 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = THIS.id }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = cwcm_t_nw }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quorum = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = 99 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_failed = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. The members bound by file 8: every member for a decision; for a recommendation the players who voted For and the passive members.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_bind = {
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s8_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				OR = {
					is_ai = yes
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 5 }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s8_issue } check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 1 } }
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { global.cwcm_s8_part = THIS }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 8 after an adopted vote.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_passed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	# the partner or applicant of the file no longer exists: the file closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s8_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_free = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwcm_s8_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_status = 4 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 6 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jul1 = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_next }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = global.num_days }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 90 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 8 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_target > 0 }
					var:global.cwcm_s8_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_ptime = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_since = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_len = 60 }
				var:global.cwcm_s8_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev4_item = global.cwcm_s8_item } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.4 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_accept = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_transp > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_transp }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_phase_for = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_apply = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 8 rejected; one-off items return after 180 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_failed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_free = yes
}

# Any scope. File 8 enters into force (for the members bound by it).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_apply = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	clear_array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_s8_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwcm_ctx_part = THIS } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s8_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the partner or applicant no longer exists: nothing enters into force
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s8_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_accession_effective = yes }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_project = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_aid = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_free = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 8 accepts (or is a passive country).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_accept = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_due = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_apply = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 8 declines or does not answer in 60 days of play.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_decline = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_by > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_s8_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwcm_s8_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s8_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 7 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_target = global.cwcm_s8_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Offers wait for players: the deadline only runs in weeks when the partner is played; a passive country accepts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s8_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_decline = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s8_target = { is_ai = no } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_ptime = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_ptime < 60 } } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_decline = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s8_target = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_accept = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Starts the national ratification of file 8: players decide within 365 days, passive members after their period.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_rat_begin = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_8 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_8 = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_8 = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_8 = cwcm_ratdays }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ev3_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.3 }
	}
}

# Any scope. File 8 goes to the national ratifications.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_start_ratify = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_rat_begin = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Weekly step of the ratification of file 8.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_rat_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 1 } check_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwcm_ratdue_8 } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_rat_failer = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly ratification check of file 8; in force one month after the last ratification.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ratify_tick = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_rat_step = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = global.cwcm_rat_failer }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock_defeat = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 9 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 20 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Ratify file 8 by the national assembly (90 days, 25 political power).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_rat_parliament = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_8 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_8 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_8 = 90 }
	add_political_power = -25
}

# Country scope. Refuses to ratify file 8; the change of the Charter fails.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_rat_refuse = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_8 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 8.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 10 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_s8_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { COLDWAR_CMEA_project_slot_free = yes AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_item > 120 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_item < 140 } } } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 9 into the read-only context used by item effects and texts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_slot = 9 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = global.cwcm_s9_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_phase = global.cwcm_s9_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_stage = global.cwcm_s9_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_due = global.cwcm_s9_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_issue = global.cwcm_s9_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target = global.cwcm_s9_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_opt = global.cwcm_s9_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_size = global.cwcm_s9_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ret = global.cwcm_s9_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_by = global.cwcm_s9_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ticket = global.cwcm_s9_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ptime = global.cwcm_s9_ptime }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_since = global.cwcm_s9_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_len = global.cwcm_s9_len }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_proc = global.cwcm_s9_proc }
}

# Any scope. Closes file 9.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_free = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_unbusy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 9 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_9 = 0 }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s9_part
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_ptime = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_len = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_proc = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 9 waits for the Executive Committee (or the June Session).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_ticket = global.cwcm_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 9.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_due = cwcm_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_len = cwcm_t_days }
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 9 with the temp request (cwcm_t_item, target, opt, size, ret).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_item = cwcm_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_target = cwcm_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_opt = cwcm_t_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_size = cwcm_t_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_ret = cwcm_t_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_stage = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_by = THIS.id }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_ptime = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_busy = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_pay_request = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s9_target = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_draft = 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 1 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_workload = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_load }
		round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_days
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_phase_for = yes
		# the Secretary sees the draft on the desk and may table it at once or decline it
	}
}

# Any scope. File 9 goes to the vote for 30 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_open_vote = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_effective_rules = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_phase_for = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 9 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_due = global.cwcm_s9_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = cwcm_t_thr_eff }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ep = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_stage = global.cwcm_s9_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_item = global.cwcm_s9_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_target = global.cwcm_s9_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_size = global.cwcm_s9_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_opt = global.cwcm_s9_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ret = global.cwcm_s9_ret }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.1 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts the players on file 9; adopted files move on, rejected files close.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_close = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = cwcm_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 } }
		# a resolution of the catalogue makes world news in the next step (passed); other files notify the members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_bind = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			# world news: under the rules of consent an Against blocks - the news names the first player member that voted Against
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_last_na > 0 }
					OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 4 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwcm_members
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
							is_ai = no
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s9_issue }
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 2 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = THIS.id }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = cwcm_t_nw }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quorum = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = 99 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_failed = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. The members bound by file 9: every member for a decision; for a recommendation the players who voted For and the passive members.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_bind = {
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s9_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				OR = {
					is_ai = yes
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 5 }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s9_issue } check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 1 } }
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { global.cwcm_s9_part = THIS }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 9 after an adopted vote.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_passed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	# the partner or applicant of the file no longer exists: the file closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s9_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_free = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwcm_s9_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_status = 4 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 6 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jul1 = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_next }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = global.num_days }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 90 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 8 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_target > 0 }
					var:global.cwcm_s9_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_ptime = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_since = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_len = 60 }
				var:global.cwcm_s9_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev4_item = global.cwcm_s9_item } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.4 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_accept = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_transp > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_transp }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_phase_for = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_apply = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 9 rejected; one-off items return after 180 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_failed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_free = yes
}

# Any scope. File 9 enters into force (for the members bound by it).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_apply = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	clear_array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_s9_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwcm_ctx_part = THIS } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s9_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the partner or applicant no longer exists: nothing enters into force
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s9_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_accession_effective = yes }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_project = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_aid = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_free = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 9 accepts (or is a passive country).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_accept = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_due = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_apply = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 9 declines or does not answer in 60 days of play.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_decline = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_by > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_s9_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwcm_s9_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s9_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 7 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_target = global.cwcm_s9_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Offers wait for players: the deadline only runs in weeks when the partner is played; a passive country accepts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s9_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_decline = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s9_target = { is_ai = no } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_ptime = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_ptime < 60 } } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_decline = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s9_target = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_accept = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Starts the national ratification of file 9: players decide within 365 days, passive members after their period.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_rat_begin = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_9 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_9 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_9 = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_9 = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_9 = cwcm_ratdays }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ev3_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.3 }
	}
}

# Any scope. File 9 goes to the national ratifications.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_start_ratify = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ctx = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_rat_begin = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Weekly step of the ratification of file 9.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_rat_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_9 = 1 } check_variable = { cwcm_rat_9 = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwcm_ratdue_9 } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_9 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_9 = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_rat_failer = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_9 = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_9 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly ratification check of file 9; in force one month after the last ratification.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ratify_tick = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_rat_step = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = global.cwcm_rat_failer }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock_defeat = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 9 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 20 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Ratify file 9 by the national assembly (90 days, 25 political power).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_rat_parliament = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_9 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_9 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_9 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_9 = 90 }
	add_political_power = -25
}

# Country scope. Refuses to ratify file 9; the change of the Charter fails.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_rat_refuse = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_9 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 9.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 10 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_s9_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { COLDWAR_CMEA_project_slot_free = yes AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_item > 120 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s9_item < 140 } } } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s9_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Copies file 10 into the read-only context used by item effects and texts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ctx = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_slot = 10 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_item = global.cwcm_s10_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_phase = global.cwcm_s10_phase }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_stage = global.cwcm_s10_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_due = global.cwcm_s10_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_issue = global.cwcm_s10_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_target = global.cwcm_s10_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_opt = global.cwcm_s10_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_size = global.cwcm_s10_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ret = global.cwcm_s10_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_by = global.cwcm_s10_by }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ticket = global.cwcm_s10_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_ptime = global.cwcm_s10_ptime }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_since = global.cwcm_s10_since }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_len = global.cwcm_s10_len }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_proc = global.cwcm_s10_proc }
}

# Any scope. Closes file 10.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_free = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_unbusy = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 10 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
	}
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_10 = 0 }
	}
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s10_part
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_item = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_stage = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_issue = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_target = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_opt = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_size = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_ret = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_by = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_ticket = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_ptime = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_since = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_len = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_proc = 0 }
}

# Any scope. File 10 waits for the Executive Committee (or the June Session).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_to_queue = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 2 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_ticket = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_ticket = global.cwcm_ticket }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_days: deadline of the current phase of file 10.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_phase_for = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = cwcm_t_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_len = cwcm_t_days }
}

# Country scope (requesting player). Opens file 10 with the temp request (cwcm_t_item, target, opt, size, ret).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_open = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_item = cwcm_t_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_target = cwcm_t_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_opt = cwcm_t_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_size = cwcm_t_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_ret = cwcm_t_ret }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_stage = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_by = THIS.id }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_ptime = 0 }
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_busy = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_pay_request = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_target > 0 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s10_target = { if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen days = 365 value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_draft = 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_to_queue = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 1 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_workload = yes
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_draft }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_load }
		round_temp_variable = cwcm_t_days
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_phase_for = yes
		# the Secretary sees the draft on the desk and may table it at once or decline it
	}
}

# Any scope. File 10 goes to the vote for 30 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_open_vote = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_effective_rules = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 3 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_phase_for = yes
	add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_issue = 1 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 10 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_issue = global.cwcm_issue }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_due = global.cwcm_s10_due }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = cwcm_t_thr_eff }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ep = 0 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_proc = cwcm_t_proc }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_stage = global.cwcm_s10_stage }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_item = global.cwcm_s10_item }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_target = global.cwcm_s10_target }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_size = global.cwcm_s10_size }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_opt = global.cwcm_s10_opt }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_ret = global.cwcm_s10_ret }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev1_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.1 } }
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
}

# Any scope. Counts the players on file 10; adopted files move on, rejected files close.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_close = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_tally = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
