	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = cwcm_t_res }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 0 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 } }
		# a resolution of the catalogue makes world news in the next step (passed); other files notify the members
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_bind = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_passed = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			# world news: under the rules of consent an Against blocks - the news names the first player member that voted Against
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_last_na > 0 }
					OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 4 } } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
				for_each_scope_loop = {
					array = global.cwcm_members
					if = {
						limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = 0 }
							is_ai = no
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s10_issue }
							check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 2 } }
						set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nw = THIS.id }
					}
				}
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 10 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = cwcm_t_nw }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quorum = 0 } }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = 99 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 11 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_failed = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. The members bound by file 10: every member for a decision; for a recommendation the players who voted For and the passive members.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_bind = {
	clear_array = global.cwcm_s10_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = yes
				OR = {
					is_ai = yes
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 }
					check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 5 }
					AND = { check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_s10_issue } check_variable = { cwcm_vote = 1 } }
				}
			}
			add_to_array = { global.cwcm_s10_part = THIS }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Next step of file 10 after an adopted vote.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_passed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	# the partner or applicant of the file no longer exists: the file closes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s10_target = { exists = yes } } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 17 }
		for_each_scope_loop = {
			array = global.cwcm_members
			if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_free = yes
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 3 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 4 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_start_ratify = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 8 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			var:global.cwcm_s10_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_status = 4 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 6 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_next_jul1 = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_next }
			subtract_from_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = global.num_days }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 10 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 90 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_phase_for = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 8 } } }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_target > 0 }
					var:global.cwcm_s10_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 3 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 7 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_ptime = 0 }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_since = global.num_days }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_len = 60 }
				var:global.cwcm_s10_target = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev4_item = global.cwcm_s10_item } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.4 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
					set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
				}
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_accept = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 1 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_transp > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
			}
			set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 6 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = cwcm_t_transp }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_phase_for = yes
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 }
			}
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_apply = yes
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 0 }
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. File 10 rejected; one-off items return after 180 days.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_failed = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_free = yes
}

# Any scope. File 10 enters into force (for the members bound by it).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_apply = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ctx = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_props = yes
	clear_array = global.cwcm_ctx_part
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_s10_part
		if = { limit = { exists = yes COLDWAR_CMEA_is_member = yes } add_to_array = { global.cwcm_ctx_part = THIS } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_target > 0 }
			NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s10_target = { exists = yes } } }
		# the partner or applicant no longer exists: nothing enters into force
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 7 } }
		var:global.cwcm_s10_target = { COLDWAR_CMEA_accession_effective = yes }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 10 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_project = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_proc = 11 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_start_aid = yes
	}
	else = {
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_apply = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_quiet = 1 } } }
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev5_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.5 } }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_free = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_settlement_recompute = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_refresh_all = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 10 accepts (or is a passive country).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_accept = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 6 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_due = global.num_days }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_apply = yes
}

# Any scope. The partner of file 10 declines or does not answer in 60 days of play.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_decline = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ctx = yes
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 7 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_by > 0 } }
		if = {
			limit = { var:global.cwcm_s10_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
			var:global.cwcm_s10_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s10_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 7 } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_target = global.cwcm_s10_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_free = yes
}

# Any scope. Offers wait for players: the deadline only runs in weeks when the partner is played; a passive country accepts.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_offer_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { var:global.cwcm_s10_target = { exists = yes } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_decline = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s10_target = { is_ai = no } }
		add_to_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_ptime = 7 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_ptime < 60 } } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_decline = yes
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:global.cwcm_s10_target = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_player_seen } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_accept = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Starts the national ratification of file 10: players decide within 365 days, passive members after their period.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_rat_begin = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_10 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_10 = 0 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_10 = global.num_days }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_seen_player = yes }
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_10 = 365 }
	}
	else = {
		add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_10 = cwcm_ratdays }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		set_variable = { cwcm_ev3_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
		country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.3 }
	}
}

# Any scope. File 10 goes to the national ratifications.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_start_ratify = {
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 5 }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_since = global.num_days }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_len = 0 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ctx = yes
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_rat_begin = yes
	}
}

# Country scope. Weekly step of the ratification of file 10.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_rat_step = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_10 = 1 } check_variable = { cwcm_rat_10 = 2 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < cwcm_ratdue_10 } } }
		set_variable = { cwcm_rat_10 = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_10 = 6 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_rat_failer = THIS.id }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_10 = 3 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_rat_10 = 0 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 0 }
	}
}

# Any scope. Weekly ratification check of file 10; in force one month after the last ratification.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ratify_tick = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ctx = yes
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_rat_step = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_failed = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 8 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 14 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = global.cwcm_rat_failer }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_ctx_lock_defeat = yes
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_free = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_all = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 6 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_phase_for = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 9 }
		if = {
			limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_news_known = yes }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_res = 20 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_by = global.cwcm_ctx_by }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_who = 0 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_a = global.cwcm_last_nf }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_b = global.cwcm_last_nn }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_c = global.cwcm_last_na }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n_d = global.cwcm_floor_thr }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_news = yes
		}
		else = {
			for_each_scope_loop = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				if = { limit = { is_ai = no } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_item = global.cwcm_ctx_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_res = global.cwcm_ctx_res } set_variable = { cwcm_ev2_target = global.cwcm_ctx_target } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.2 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Ratify file 10 by the national assembly (90 days, 25 political power).
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_rat_parliament = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_10 = 2 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratmode_10 = 1 }
	set_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_10 = global.num_days }
	add_to_variable = { cwcm_ratdue_10 = 90 }
	add_political_power = -25
}

# Country scope. Refuses to ratify file 10; the change of the Charter fails.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_rat_refuse = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_rat_10 = 6 }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ratify_tick = yes
}

# Any scope. Weekly deadlines of file 10.
COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_ratify_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_offer_tick = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 10 } }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_s10_due } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_to_queue = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_apply = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_phase = 10 } }
			if = {
				limit = { OR = { COLDWAR_CMEA_project_slot_free = yes AND = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_item > 120 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s10_item < 140 } } } }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_apply = yes
			}
			else = {
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_days = 30 }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_s10_phase_for = yes
			}
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Deadlines of every open request file.
COLDWAR_CMEA_slots_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s5_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s6_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_tick = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase > 0 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_tick = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. Closes a vote at its deadline and opens the next one.
COLDWAR_CMEA_floor_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor > 0 }
			NOT = { check_variable = { global.num_days < global.cwcm_floor_due } } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_close_vote = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
}

# Any scope. Closes the vote on the floor.
COLDWAR_CMEA_close_vote = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 2 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 3 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s5_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 6 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s6_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_close = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 8 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_close = yes
	}
}

# Any scope. One vote at a time, in the order of the agenda; changes of the Charter and admissions only at the June Session.
COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor = 0 }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_any_player_member = yes }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = 999999 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_ticket < cwcm_t_best }
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_proc = 3 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_proc = 7 } } }
					has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_session
			} }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = global.cwcm_s1_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_ticket < cwcm_t_best }
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_proc = 3 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_proc = 7 } } }
					has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_session
			} }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = global.cwcm_s2_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_ticket < cwcm_t_best }
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_proc = 3 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_proc = 7 } } }
					has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_session
			} }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = global.cwcm_s3_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_ticket < cwcm_t_best }
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_proc = 3 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_proc = 7 } } }
					has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_session
			} }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = global.cwcm_s4_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_ticket < cwcm_t_best }
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_proc = 3 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_proc = 7 } } }
					has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_session
			} }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = global.cwcm_s5_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_ticket < cwcm_t_best }
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_proc = 3 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_proc = 7 } } }
					has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_session
			} }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = global.cwcm_s6_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_ticket < cwcm_t_best }
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_proc = 3 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_proc = 7 } } }
					has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_session
			} }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = global.cwcm_s7_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 2 }
				check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_ticket < cwcm_t_best }
				OR = {
					NOT = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_proc = 3 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_proc = 7 } } }
					has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_session
			} }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_best = global.cwcm_s8_ticket }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 1 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 2 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 3 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 4 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 5 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s5_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 6 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s6_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 7 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_open_vote = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_bests = 8 } }
			COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_open_vote = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Counts only members governed by players, one vote each: For, Against, Not interested. temp cwcm_t_res: 0 no players, 1 adopted, 2 rejected.
COLDWAR_CMEA_tally = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nv = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nf = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 0 }
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nn = 0 }
	for_each_scope_loop = {
		array = global.cwcm_members
		if = {
			limit = { is_ai = no }
			add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n = 1 }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_gv = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_floor_issue } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nv = 1 }
				set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_gv = cwcm_vote }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_gv = 1 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nf = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_gv = 2 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 1 }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_gv = 3 } }
				add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nn = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
	# quorum: two votes cast, unless only one player sits in the Council
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quorum = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_nv > 1 } check_variable = { cwcm_t_n = 1 } } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_quorum = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_ok = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 2 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 4 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_na = 0 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_nf > 0 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_quorum = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_ok = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 5 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nf3 = cwcm_t_nf }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_nf3 = 3 }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n2 = cwcm_t_n }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_n2 = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_nf3 < cwcm_t_n2 } }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_quorum = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_ok = 1 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor_thr = 6 } }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_nf > 0 }
				check_variable = { cwcm_t_quorum = 1 } }
			set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_ok = 1 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_ok = 1 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_n = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_res = 0 }
	}
	# results kept for the window and the news
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_last_n = cwcm_t_n }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_last_nf = cwcm_t_nf }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_last_na = cwcm_t_na }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_last_nn = cwcm_t_nn }
	set_variable = { global.cwcm_last_res = cwcm_t_res }
}

# Any scope. When every seated player has voted, the vote closes at once.
COLDWAR_CMEA_check_all_voted = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_floor > 0 }
			all_of_scopes = {
				array = global.cwcm_members
				OR = { is_ai = yes check_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_floor_issue } }
		} }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_close_vote = yes
	}
}

# Country scope (player member). temp cwcm_t_v: 1 For, 2 Against, 3 Not interested. A vote can be changed until the vote closes.
COLDWAR_CMEA_cast_vote = {
	set_variable = { cwcm_vote = cwcm_t_v }
	set_variable = { cwcm_vote_issue = global.cwcm_floor_issue }
	COLDWAR_CMEA_vote_preview = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_check_all_voted = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_load: workload of the Secretariat, +15 % per procedure beyond three (at most +60 %).
COLDWAR_CMEA_workload = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_act = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_act = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 1 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 5 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 6 } check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 10 } } }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_act = 1 }
	}
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_load = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_act > 3 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = cwcm_t_act }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = -3 }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_x = 0.15 }
		add_to_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_load = cwcm_t_x }
		clamp_temp_variable = { var = cwcm_t_load max = 1.6 }
	}
}

# Country scope. Pays the request (the Secretary pays half; after the summit of 1984 the Chair tables one proposal a year free of charge).
COLDWAR_CMEA_pay_request = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pay = cwcm_t_cost }
	if = {
		limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_secretary = yes }
		multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pay = 0.5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_chair_free
			NOT = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_chair_free_used }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_pres = THIS.id } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pay = 0 }
		set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_chair_free_used
	}
	multiply_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_pay = -1 }
	add_political_power = cwcm_t_pay
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_slot: first free request file (0 = the Secretariat is full).
COLDWAR_CMEA_find_slot = {
	set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 2 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 7 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 0 }
			check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 0 } }
		set_temp_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 8 }
	}
}

# Country scope (player member). Opens a file for the request in temp cwcm_t_item, cwcm_t_target, cwcm_t_opt, cwcm_t_size, cwcm_t_ret.
COLDWAR_CMEA_request = {
	COLDWAR_CMEA_find_slot = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 2 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 3 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s5_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 6 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s6_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_open = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 8 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_open = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_touch = yes
}

# Country scope (the Secretary, a player). temp cwcm_t_slot: declines to table a requested draft.
COLDWAR_CMEA_decline_draft = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_by > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwcm_s1_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
				var:global.cwcm_s1_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s1_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 10 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 2 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_by > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwcm_s2_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
				var:global.cwcm_s2_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s2_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 10 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 3 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_by > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwcm_s3_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
				var:global.cwcm_s3_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s3_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 10 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 4 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_by > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwcm_s4_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
				var:global.cwcm_s4_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s4_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 10 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 5 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s5_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_by > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwcm_s5_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
				var:global.cwcm_s5_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s5_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 10 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s5_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 6 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s6_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_by > 0 } }
			if = {
				limit = { var:global.cwcm_s6_by = { exists = yes is_ai = no } }
				var:global.cwcm_s6_by = { set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_item = global.cwcm_s6_item } set_variable = { cwcm_ev6_res = 10 } country_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.6 } }
			}
		}
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s6_free = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 7 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_ctx = yes
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_ctx_res = 10 }
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_by > 0 } }

	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 8 } }

	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_touch = yes
}

# Country scope (the Secretary, a player). temp cwcm_t_slot: tables a requested draft at once.
COLDWAR_CMEA_table_now = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 1 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s1_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 2 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s2_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 3 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s3_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 4 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s4_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 5 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s5_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 6 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s6_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 7 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s7_to_queue = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 8 }
			check_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_phase = 1 } }
		COLDWAR_CMEA_s8_to_queue = yes
	}
	COLDWAR_CMEA_touch = yes
}

# Any scope. temp cwcm_t_slot: the Chair puts a file first on the agenda (once per term).
COLDWAR_CMEA_bring_forward = {
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 1 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s1_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 2 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s2_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 3 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s3_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 4 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s4_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 5 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s5_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 6 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s6_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 7 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s7_ticket = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { cwcm_t_slot = 8 } }
		set_variable = { global.cwcm_s8_ticket = 0 }
	}
	set_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_pres_forward_used
	COLDWAR_CMEA_try_open_vote = yes
	COLDWAR_CMEA_touch = yes
}

# Any scope. temp <V>t_n_*: one world news for every player (queued: one news at a time, each with its own values).
COLDWAR_CMEA_news = {
	every_country = {
		limit = { is_ai = no }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_nq_item = cwcm_t_n_item }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_nq_res = cwcm_t_n_res }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_nq_target = cwcm_t_n_target }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_nq_by = cwcm_t_n_by }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_nq_who = cwcm_t_n_who }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_nq_a = cwcm_t_n_a }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_nq_b = cwcm_t_n_b }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_nq_c = cwcm_t_n_c }
		add_to_array = { cwcm_nq_d = cwcm_t_n_d }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_news_busy } }
			set_country_flag = { flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_news_busy days = 30 value = 1 }
			news_event = { id = COLDWAR_CMEA.30 }
		}
	}
}
